standouts.head: MACD just turned up
standouts.text: MACD crossed above its signal line on Nov 11, above zero: momentum renewing in the trend's direction.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

against.head: Buying is losing force
against.text: A higher high in price (Nov 5) against a lower high in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): regular bearish divergence.
against.learn: Higher price highs with falling momentum highs: buyers are tiring.

against.head: Resistance +1.6% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.6% above (0.4 ATR), where 5 levels (2 kinds) meet: the Oct 23 high, the most-traded price of six months and the Oct 30 high: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Jul 9 low, the average price paid since the Oct 23 high and the 38.2% retracement of the Nov 3–Nov 5 rise, where 7 levels (4 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: Selling is losing force (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a lower low in price (the week of Sep 28) against a higher low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.

material.head: Next support −3% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −3% below (0.8 ATR), where 12 levels (3 kinds) meet: the Jun 22 low, the 50-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Nov 3–Nov 5 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Holding its rising 20-day
material.text: It dipped to its rising 20-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.
